neighbours.label: a word that sets the scope of a stated count or amount: 'alone' after a year or place ('In 2019 alone, forty stores...'), 'per meal', 'at one time', 'each of them', as against 'alone' meaning solitary
fire: Measles spread fast; in Ohio alone, more than three hundred cases were reported.
The storm was costly, and in Florida alone the damage topped ten billion dollars.
Sales soared; in 2021 alone, the firm sold two million bikes.
Poaching is rising, and in Kenya alone forty rhinos were killed last year.
The fire burned for weeks; in the first month alone, ninety homes were lost.
Tourism boomed, and in July alone the island had half a million visitors.
The library grew fast; in 1890 alone it added twelve thousand books.
Floods hit the region, and in Bangladesh alone a million people fled.
quiet: Measles spread fast; the sick boy stayed alone in his room for a week.
The storm was costly, and the old man rode it out alone in Florida.
Sales soared, but the founder still worked alone in a small shed.
Poaching is rising, and rangers in Kenya rarely patrol alone at night.
The fire burned for weeks; one firefighter was left alone on the ridge.
Tourism boomed, yet she walked alone on the empty beach in July.
The library grew fast; the old clerk catalogued every book alone.
Floods hit the region, and the child waited alone on a rooftop.
